# Compliance Assessment

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ComplianceAssessment`](gmeow-ComplianceAssessment.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ComplianceAssessment>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)

An observation that an event complied with or violated a norm — vantage = the assessor. The reified form of [`gmeow:violates`](../properties/gmeow-violates.md) / [`gmeow:complies`](../properties/gmeow-complies.md), for when who-judged, on-what-evidence, and how-confidently must be first-class. Two assessors disagreeing are two coexisting cells; no global compliance verdict exists ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ComplianceAssessment`](gmeow-ComplianceAssessment.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
